title: Riot X Nic Salts Blueberry Peach Fizz 10ml E-Liquid
description: Blueberry Peach Fizz from Riot X delivers a lively fusion of rich berries and succulent stone fruit, lifted by a fizzy, sherbet-like sparkle. The deep, juicy flavour of ripe blueberries meets the soft, golden sweetness of peach, creating a smooth and well-rounded fruit medley. A subtle effervescent note adds a playful, tingling sensation, making each inhale bright and refreshing. Part of Riot Squad’s Riot X collection, this e-liquid is crafted to replicate the intense, double-concentrated flavours found in the most popular single-use disposables. Supplied in a 10ml bottle, it’s an excellent choice for vapers switching from disposables to refillable MTL (mouth-to-lung) pod kits, offering the same vibrant taste with the added benefits of convenience and cost efficiency. Please note: this flavour profile may contain hints of 'ice'. Riot X Salt E-Liquids are made with Riot Squad’s Hybrid Nicotine blend, a combination of freebase nicotine and nicotine salts. This innovative mix, along with the 50PG/50VG ratio, ensures a well-balanced vape with bold flavour, a smooth throat hit, and satisfying vapour production.
